title: Terms used in the dars
summary: A short glossary of the words Hazrat Azam Pasha R.A. uses, each explained only as he explains it, with where to hear it.

blocks.p: Each term is given only as Hazrat explains it. In brackets: HB 1 and 2 are the Haqeeqat-e-Bai'at recordings; NA 1 to 9 the parts of Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara; Dars the dars on the soul and the scale.
Bai'at (iradat): a covenant; 'taking a pledge on something important'. 'Becoming a murid, that is bai'at.' [HB 1, 3:26 and 22:34]
Bai'at-e-barakat: bai'at taken for blessing from small children who do not yet understand. [HB 1, 19:00]
Shaykh, murshid: 'The word shaykh itself means murshid': the one you have taken bai'at with. [HB 1, 24:25; NA 9, 0:34]
Pir: used in the saying 'Whoever has no pir, his pir is Shaytan', but not defined separately. Ask your teacher. [HB 1, 42:08]
Murid: the one who has given bai'at; Hazrat calls murids 'spiritual children'. [HB 2, 7:37]
Talib: a seeker: one who, when his teaching was not completed, takes from another shaykh. [HB 1, 13:42]
Khalifa: from khalaf, 'behind': the one who follows the one before him and carries on his work. [HB 2, 15:37]
Khilafat: 'the confirmation that a murid has become worthy'. It comes from above and is not to be asked for. [HB 2, 11:57]
Tawbah: regret, turning to Allah, and making good what one owes others; 'a quality of the heart'. [NA 2, 4:48]
Taqwa: 'to keep away from everything that harms you'. [NA 3, 1:12]
Tawakkul: 'to rely on Allah for your needs'. 'Not working is not tawakkul.' [NA 3, 6:04]
Istikhara: 'Whatever work you have to do, do it by asking Allah.' [NA 3, 10:08]
Qurb-e-Faraiz, Qurb-e-Nawafil: nearness through what Allah commands, and through good done by one's own intention. [NA 3, 11:53]
Sabr, Tasleem, Raza: bearing hardship though the heart finds it hard; accepting it without resentment; being pleased however Allah keeps you. [NA 4, 5:48 to 14:56]
Fana-e-af'aal: the effacement of one's own acts, once the nafs is refined. Other kinds of fana, and baqa, are not explained. Ask your teacher. [NA 4, 29:49; NA 1, 57:02]
Chilla: sitting for forty days in worship. 'What is a chilla? It is i'tikaf.' [NA 8, 2:52 and 12:51]
Saum-e-Maryam: fasting all day and speaking to no one. [NA 8, 14:28]
Hizbul Bahr: read with fasting and silence until a fixed count is complete. Ask your teacher. [NA 8, 7:09]
Mu'akkil: Hazrat says Hizbul Bahr has 'very strict mu'akkils', but does not define the word. Ask your teacher. [NA 8, 22:16]
Khatra, 'azm: a khatra is a thought that comes and goes, and is forgiven; 'azm is a firm resolve on it, and is not. [NA 6, 1:57]
Nazar bar qadam: keep your gaze on your steps. [NA 6, 9:03]
Khalwat dar anjuman: solitude in the crowd: keep your attention in your heart. [NA 6, 9:16]
Yaad-faramosh: a pact so that the remembrance of Allah never breaks; faramoshi means forgetting. [NA 7, 10:13]
Tasawwur-e-shaykh: holding the shaykh in your thought, so that the thought becomes fixed on one point. [NA 9, 0:49]
Muraqaba: named (a book 'Muraqaba aur Kashf'), not defined. Ask your teacher. [NA 6, 19:37]
Kashf: an opening in which 'Allah shows whatever He wishes to show'. It must be presented to the Qur'an and Hadith. [NA 9, 6:30; NA 3, 30:36]
Aalam-e-Misaal: the world of examples, where the soul was given a form; what is shown in kashf is shown there. [Dars, 1:03; NA 3, 32:28]

blocks.note: Sarkar: in these translations it means the Prophet ﷺ or the shaykh, by context. Where the context is unclear, ask your teacher.

ru.title: Dars mein aane wale alfaaz
ru.summary: Hazrat Azam Pasha R.A. jo alfaaz istemaal karte hain unki mukhtasar farhang: har lafz sirf utna jitna woh khud samjhaate hain, aur kahaan sunein.

blocks.p: Har lafz sirf usi tarah diya gaya hai jaise Hazrat samjhaate hain. Brackets mein: HB 1 aur 2 Haqeeqat-e-Bai'at ki recordings hain; NA 1 se 9 Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara ke parts; Dars yaani rooh aur meezaan wala dars.
Bai'at (iradat): ek mu'ahida; 'kisi aham cheez par ahad lena'. 'Jo murid hona hai, woh bai'at hai.' [HB 1, 3:26 aur 22:34]
Bai'at-e-barakat: chhote kam-samajh bachchon se barakat ke liye li jaane wali bai'at. [HB 1, 19:00]
Shaykh, murshid: 'Shaykh ka matlab hi murshid hai': jinse aapne bai'at ki hai. [HB 1, 24:25; NA 9, 0:34]
Pir: is qaul mein aata hai 'Jiska koi pir nahin, uska pir Shaitaan hai', lekin alag se iski tareef nahin ki gayi. Apne ustaad se poochiye. [HB 1, 42:08]
Murid: jisne bai'at ki ho; Hazrat murideen ko 'roohani aulaad' kehte hain. [HB 2, 7:37]
Talib: talabgaar: jiski ta'leem poori na hui ho aur woh doosre shaykh se le. [HB 1, 13:42]
Khalifa: khalaf se, yaani 'peechhe': jo apne se pehle wale ke peechhe chale aur uska kaam aage badhaaye. [HB 2, 15:37]
Khilafat: 'is baat ki tasdeeq ke murid laayeq ho gaya hai'. Yeh upar se aati hai aur maangi nahin jaati. [HB 2, 11:57]
Tauba: nadaamat, Allah ki taraf rujoo', aur doosron ka jo haq ho usko ada karna; 'dil ki ek sifat'. [NA 2, 4:48]
Taqwa: 'har us cheez se bachna jo aapko nuqsaan de'. [NA 3, 1:12]
Tawakkul: 'apni zarooraton ke liye Allah par bharosa karna'. 'Kaam na karna tawakkul nahin hai.' [NA 3, 6:04]
Istikhara: 'Jo bhi kaam karna ho, Allah se poochh kar karo.' [NA 3, 10:08]
Qurb-e-Faraiz, Qurb-e-Nawafil: Allah ke hukm wali cheezon ke zariye qurb, aur apni niyyat se kiye gaye nek kaamon ke zariye qurb. [NA 3, 11:53]
Sabr, Tasleem, Raza: takleef bardaasht karna chaahe dil ko mushkil lage; bina naaraazgi ke usko qubool karna; Allah jaise bhi rakhe us mein raazi rehna. [NA 4, 5:48 se 14:56]
Fana-e-af'aal: nafs ki islaah ke baad apne afaal ka mit jaana. Fana ki doosri qismein, aur baqa, samjhaayi nahin gayin. Apne ustaad se poochiye. [NA 4, 29:49; NA 1, 57:02]
Chilla: ibaadat mein chaalees din baithna. 'Chilla kya hai? I'tikaf hai.' [NA 8, 2:52 aur 12:51]
Saum-e-Maryam: din bhar roza aur kisi se baat na karna. [NA 8, 14:28]
Hizbul Bahr: roze aur khaamoshi ke saath padha jaata hai jab tak ek muqarrar ginti poori na ho. Apne ustaad se poochiye. [NA 8, 7:09]
Mu'akkil: Hazrat farmate hain ke Hizbul Bahr ke 'bahut sakht mu'akkil' hain, lekin lafz ki tareef nahin karte. Apne ustaad se poochiye. [NA 8, 22:16]
Khatra, 'azm: khatra woh khayal hai jo aata aur jaata hai, aur maaf hai; 'azm us par pakka iraada hai, aur maaf nahin. [NA 6, 1:57]
Nazar bar qadam: apni nazar apne qadmon par rakho. [NA 6, 9:03]
Khalwat dar anjuman: bheed mein tanhaai: apni tawajjoh apne dil mein rakho. [NA 6, 9:16]
Yaad-faramosh: ek mu'ahida taaki Allah ki yaad kabhi na toote; faramoshi yaani bhool jaana. [NA 7, 10:13]
Tasawwur-e-shaykh: shaykh ko apne khayal mein rakhna, taaki khayal ek nukte par jam jaaye. [NA 9, 0:49]
Muraqaba: naam aaya hai (ek kitaab 'Muraqaba aur Kashf'), tareef nahin. Apne ustaad se poochiye. [NA 6, 19:37]
Kashf: ek khulna jis mein 'Allah jo dikhaana chahta hai dikhaata hai'. Isko Qur'an aur Hadith par pesh karna zaroori hai. [NA 9, 6:30; NA 3, 30:36]
Aalam-e-Misaal: misaal ki duniya, jahaan rooh ko soorat di gayi; kashf mein jo dikhaaya jaata hai wahin dikhaaya jaata hai. [Dars, 1:03; NA 3, 32:28]

blocks.note: Sarkar: in tarjumon mein iska matlab Huzoor ﷺ ya shaykh hai, siyaaq ke hisaab se. Jahaan siyaaq saaf na ho, apne ustaad se poochiye.
